top.title: Roche Gets FDA Approval for Enspryng in Thyroid Eye Disease
top.summary: Roche announced FDA approval of Enspryng (satralizumab) for thyroid eye disease (TED), marking the drug's second approved indication. The approval was based on phase III SatraGO-2 study data showing significant improvements in eye bulging and double vision symptoms. Enspryng is also under priority FDA review for MOGAD treatment, with a decision expected January 10, 2027.

top.title: FDA approves Roche’s Enspryng, a first-in-class IL-6R inhibitor, as the first and only at-home subcutaneous treatment option for thyroid eye disease (TED)
top.summary: The FDA has approved Roche's Enspryng (satralizumab) as the first at-home subcutaneous treatment for thyroid eye disease (TED). The approval was based on Phase III SatraGO-1 and -2 studies, with SatraGO-2 demonstrating significant reductions in eye bulging (proptosis) and improvements in double vision (diplopia). Enspryng is an IL-6R inhibitor using novel recycling antibody technology and represents the second indication for the drug, following its 2020 approval for neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD).

top.title: Obesity Clinical Trial and Competitive Landscape Surges as 200+ Companies Advance Next-Generation Therapies | DelveInsight
top.summary: Over 200 companies are advancing next-generation obesity therapies, with more than 30 drugs in late-stage development and 180+ in mid and early stages. Key players include Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, Viking Therapeutics, and Roche, developing innovative mechanisms like dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists and triple hormone receptor agonists. Recent approvals include Novo Nordisk's oral Wegovy formulation and Eli Lilly's orforglipron, while multiple Phase III trials show promising weight loss results.

top.title: Saudi Arabia Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing Market 2026-2034: Executive Report | NGS Adoption and Healthcare Investment Drive 13.35% CAGR Toward US$162.16 Million

Key players include Eurofins Scientific, Roche, Invitae, Illumina, Natera, Centogene, and Qiagen, with Riyadh and Jeddah leading regional adoption.
